events.name: The Forgotten Forest
events.intro:
A gap between two trees. It wasn't there on the way in. You're sure of it.

The light through it is older, somehow. Greener. Nothing on the far side has ever been cut.

success.text: The air changes. It smells of moss and rain that fell a hundred years ago.
When you look back, it's only two trees, close together, the way they always were.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Gap
events.intro:
Two trees lean apart. In here the light is older.

Nobody's cut anything here, or caught anything, or lit a fire. Not for centuries.

*Your lead stops, and sniffs, and steps very carefully. Birds you don't know are singing.*

success.text: It goes slowly. So do you.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Hollow Street

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*

events.intro:
A row of trees with rooms in them. A doorway in each trunk, a shelf, a hearth gone cold.

Somebody small lived here. Not people.

Wild Pokémon sit in the doorways, watching you pass. They aren't afraid. They've never needed to be.

success.text:
A shelf of acorns. A bed of moss, pressed flat by something that slept here a long time.

A small carved figure: something with wings and a leaf. It's been dusted. Recently.
The doorways watch you to the end of the row. At the last one, something steps down into your path.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: In Your Path

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*

events.intro:
One of them has come down out of its doorway, and stands in the path. A rare one. You've only seen its kind in books.

It isn't shy. It's never needed to be.

success.text: It doesn't run. Nothing here has ever needed to.

choices.label: Let it look, and walk round it.

success.text: It sniffs your boots, and lets you by. It watches you go.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Carved Stones

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*
*You've read all four. The last one stays with you.*

events.intro:
Ruins, half swallowed by roots. Four stone slabs stand in a row, carved deep and worn soft.

They show migrations that don't happen any more.

success.text: You brush the moss from the next slab, and read it with your fingers as much as your eyes.

effects.text: The first slab: many Pokémon, of every kind, walking in a line toward a great tree. Some carry their young on their backs.
The second slab: the tree, with a small winged shape in its branches. The sun is behind it, carved as a ring of points.
The third slab: people, at the forest's edge, with their hands up, palms out. Not coming in. Just letting the forest see them.
The fourth slab: the tree alone. The line of Pokémon is gone. A single tall figure with one eye stands in front of it.
*It's the same gesture that's carved on the post outside the Hidden Village.*

success.text: Moss closes over the carvings behind you. Past the last slab, something is asleep in the path.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: Asleep in the Path

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*

events.intro:
Something small is asleep in a patch of sun, right where the path goes. It opens one eye. It doesn't get up.

Nothing has ever made it get up.

success.text: It doesn't run. Nothing here has ever needed to.
You go round, through the ferns. It shuts its eye again.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Colony Roads

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*

events.intro:
A Bug colony's paths cross yours, worn deep into the roots by more feet than you can count. They have right of way.

*A line of Sewaddle, each carrying a leaf, goes by. It goes by for a very long time.*

choices.label: Wait for the line to pass.

success.text: You wait. The last Sewaddle looks up as it passes, and seems to nod.
The line breaks around you. Three of them turn.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: A Clearing

remembers.notice: *It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*
*Two Oddish and a Sewaddle fall in beside you, as if you'd been expected.*

events.intro:
A clearing the map didn't show. Grass. A ring of mushrooms.

The quiet is different here. Like a room somebody has only just left.

success.text: You go softly, round the ring and not through it.

then.text: In the Forgotten Forest, something green went round a trunk, and came back a moment before it left.
*It wasn't green. It was pink. It looked at you as if it already knew you.*

effects.text: *Something green goes round a trunk. It comes back round the other side, a moment before it left.*

then.text: In the Forgotten Forest, a shell of yellow opened, and looked at you, and was gone.
*Its colours were wrong: darker, richer. The rare kind. The air still hums where it was.*

effects.text: *A crack of yellow between the trees. Two halves of a shell close, and open, and it's looking at you, and it's gone.*
*The mushrooms have been stepped over, recently, by something light.*

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Sacred Tree

remembers.notice: *It looks at your hands, then at your face. It knows the gesture before you make it.*
*It's very quiet. The birdsong stopped a while ago, and hasn't come back.*

events.intro:
A tree so old it's mostly hollow, and still in leaf.

*In front of it, something that looks like another tree, until its one eye opens.*

An ancient Trevenant. It doesn't speak. It looks at your hands.

choices.label: Stand still, and let it look.

success.text:
It looks for a long time. Longer than you've been alive, maybe.

Then it moves aside, slowly, the way old trees move. Birds land on it.

choices.label: Put my hands up, palms out.

success.text:
It considers. The forest holds its breath.

Then it lets you come as far as the roots, and no farther.
It doesn't make a sound. The ground does.

win.text: The birdsong doesn't come back. Not here, and not anywhere else in this region.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: Inside the Tree

remembers.notice: *Among the old leaves of the nest: the leaves of the Berry you planted. You'd know them anywhere.*

events.intro:
Inside the tree: a nest, very old, lined with leaves that are still green.

*In it, something asleep. It has been asleep a very long time.*

success.text: It opens its eyes, and looks at you, and decides.

effects.text: Old Growth: it mends a little every turn, in any weather.
Deep Roots: nothing can make it leave a fight, and it shrugs off the worst hits.
Forest's Memory: the first sleep, poison or paralysis of each battle doesn't take.
Something old woke up in the Forgotten Forest, and came with you.

events.name: The Forgotten Forest: The Roots

remembers.notice: *Among the old leaves of the nest: the leaves of the Berry you planted. You'd know them anywhere.*

events.intro:
At the roots, the Trevenant stops you with one branch.

Below it, in a hollow, something stirs, and climbs out to you, blinking.

success.text: The Trevenant watches you both. It doesn't move until you're gone.

effects.text: Old Growth: it mends a little every turn, in any weather.
Deep Roots: nothing can make it leave a fight, and it shrugs off the worst hits.
Forest's Memory: the first sleep, poison or paralysis of each battle doesn't take.
Something old woke up in the Forgotten Forest, and came with you.

events.name: No Birdsong
events.intro:
A stand of trees by the road. You stop, without knowing why. Then you know why.

*No birdsong. Not here either. It hasn't come back anywhere in this region, since the forest.*

success.text: You listen. Wind, and leaves, and nothing else. Your Pokémon stay close.
You walk on. Your own footsteps are the loudest thing on the road.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns
events.intro:
A crack in the rock, and light coming out of it. Not daylight. Something cleaner.

Your Pokémon go quiet. There's a hum in the stone, too low to hear, high enough to feel in your teeth.

success.text: The crack opens into a mouth, and the mouth is full of light.
The hum follows you a little way down the road, then lets you go.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Bright Mouth
events.intro:
Light from nowhere. It comes out of the walls, out of the floor, out of the air between.

On a ledge, a red crystal, the size of a fist. Free for the taking.

*A Carbink watches you from a crack in the wall. It doesn't blink. It may not be able to.*

choices.label: Take the Red crystal, for one of mine.

success.text: You hold it out to one of your Pokémon. It warms.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: The light follows you in.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Ore Gallery

remembers.notice: *The deposits are worked out. Your arms ache.*

events.intro:
Ore in the walls: veins of it, glittering. Three good places to swing at. A pool, very clear, very deep, with blue light at the bottom.

Off to one side, a warm chamber. Something red glows in there, and something big is sitting in front of it.

success.text: The rock gives. Something in it didn't want to be found.

choices.label: Send a Pokémon down for the Blue crystal.

success.text: A long dive, a long wait, and up it comes with the light in its mouth.
It stands up. It's been guarding that light a long time.
The gallery narrows into a hall of mirrors.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: A Warm Chamber
events.intro: Behind where it sat: a second Red crystal, warm as a hand.

choices.label: Take it, for one of mine.

success.text: It glows brighter as you choose.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: You leave it where it was. It keeps glowing, for nobody.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: A Blue Crystal
events.intro: The Blue crystal is cold and wet and it shows three colours, depending how you hold it.

success.text: The light goes the colour of deep water.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: The light goes the colour of old ice.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: The light goes the colour of polished steel.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: You set it back in the water.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Hall of Beams

remembers.intro:
A shaft of light, three crystal mirrors on turntables, and a dark door. The door is already open.

Somebody sang into the Crystal Hollow once, and it carried all the way down here. The door remembered.

success.text: It hums as you pass, the note you sang.

events.intro:
A shaft of light from somewhere above. Three crystal mirrors on turntables: one red, one blue, one green. A dark door.

Each mirror colours the beam. The door is waiting for something.

success.text: The turntable grinds round. The beam swings with it.

effects.text: The door gets nothing: the beam goes straight past.
The beam on the door is red. The door doesn't move.
The beam on the door is blue. The door doesn't move.
The beam on the door is violet. The door doesn't move.
The beam on the door is green. The door doesn't move.
The beam on the door is yellow. The door doesn't move.
The beam on the door is teal. The door doesn't move.
All three together: the beam goes white. The dark door grinds open.

success.text: You leave the mirrors as they are.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: Behind the Door
events.intro: Behind the door: a small room, and a White crystal on the floor, lit up by the beam you made.

success.text: It's light to hold. When you look at the walls, you can see the cracks that go somewhere.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: You leave it in its beam.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Frozen Fall
events.intro:
A waterfall, frozen mid-fall. Ice-types live in the gaps behind it. Inside the ice, a blue light.

And another door, another beam, two mirrors. Where the third should be, there's an empty turntable.

choices.label: Break the Blue crystal out of the ice.

success.text: The ice cracks. The things that live in it are not happy.

choices.label: Stand a Steel-type in the gap.

success.text: It stands on the turntable, very still, and the beam bounces off it, true as a mirror. The door opens.

choices.label: Hold the White crystal in the gap.

success.text: The White crystal catches the beam and throws it on. The door opens.
The cold follows you down.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Green Crystal
events.intro:
Behind the door, one Green crystal, on a shelf. Rare. One to a visit.

It lets a Pokémon change the way it couldn't on its own: without the stone, without the trade, without the time of day. That change is for good.

choices.label: Use it on one of mine.

success.text: The green goes into it, all at once.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: It goes in your bag. It feels like it's growing.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

success.text: You leave it on its shelf.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Deep

remembers.notice: *The White crystal shows you a crack in the wall that goes somewhere.*

success.text: A side passage, and at the end of it, something somebody left a long time ago.

events.intro:
Dark. The light doesn't reach this far.

On a plinth, alone, a Black crystal. It's cold even from here. The hum is louder, and lower.

success.text: Your fingers ache with the cold. Below you, the hum gets louder.

effects.text: *It hums. Somewhere far below, something hums back, a little lower.*

choices.label: Use the Green crystal on one of mine.

success.text: You take the Green crystal out of the bag, and hold it out.
You leave it where it is. The hum doesn't change.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Passage

remembers.notice: *The White crystal lights a seam in the passage wall. It isn't a seam. It's a way through.*

success.text: A crawl, a turn, and a pocket in the rock where something was put down a long time ago, and never fetched.

events.intro: Something comes up the passage toward you, drawn by the hum.

success.text: Its eyes catch the light.

effects.text: It sees what you're carrying, and runs.
It doesn't fight. It falls in behind you, and follows.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Passage
events.intro: It comes at you.

success.text: It's quick in the dark.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Heart

remembers.notice: *Behind you, the one that followed sits down to watch.*

events.intro:
The far wall isn't a wall. It unfolds.

*A Gigalith, twice the size it should be, grown through with crystal of every colour. It turns toward your bag.*

success.text: It reads your bag the way you'd read a face.

effects.text: *Red light runs through it like heat through iron. It is Rock and Fire now.*
*Blue light pools in its joints. It is Rock and Water now, and the water keeps changing its mind.*
*Green light, and moss, and something growing. It is Rock and Grass now. Cracks close as you watch.*
*White light, everywhere at once. It is Rock and Fairy now. It sees exactly where you are.*
*It goes dark. Rock and Dark. Your Pokémon don't want to go near it.*
*Nothing in your bag wins. It stays plain grey rock, and seems almost disappointed.*

choices.label: Use the Green crystal on one of mine.

success.text: You take the Green crystal out of the bag, and hold it out.

events.name: The Heart: The Crystal Golem
events.intro: It leans down toward your bag, and the crystals in it light up.

success.text: It comes at you like a landslide that has decided to.

phases.line: The second time, it's slower, and it looks at the bag longer.
The third time, it holds out something that isn't a hand.

asks.prompt: It's looking at the bag again.
asks.text: *It's looking at the bag again. It isn't angry. It's hungry, or it's lonely; with a rock, it's hard to tell.*

options.label: Keep everything.
options.text: You close the bag. It watches you do it.

asks.prompt: It's looking at the bag again.
asks.text: *It's looking at the bag again. It isn't angry. It's hungry, or it's lonely; with a rock, it's hard to tell.*

options.label: Keep everything.
options.text: You close the bag. It watches you do it.

options.label: The Red one.
options.text: It rolls a little way, and stops, and the Golem watches it go.

options.label: The Blue one.
options.text: It rolls a little way, and stops, and the Golem watches it go.

options.label: The Green one.
options.text: It rolls a little way, and stops, and the Golem watches it go.

options.label: The others.
options.text: You dig deeper in the bag.

options.label: The White one.
options.text: It rolls a little way, and stops, and the Golem watches it go.

options.label: The Black one.
options.text: It rolls a little way, and stops, and the Golem watches it go.

options.label: Give it the crystals.
options.text: You hold them out. It takes them, one at a time, very carefully, with something that isn't a hand. It sets them into itself. It folds back into the wall. The humming stops.

options.label: Give it the crystals.
options.text: You hold them out. It takes them, one at a time, very carefully, with something that isn't a hand. It sets them into itself. It folds back into the wall. The humming stops.

events.name: The Heart: The Golem Falls
events.intro:
It settles. The crystals in it go dim, one by one.

Among the rubble: a Hard Stone, something rare, and one crystal that hasn't gone dark yet.

success.text: You fill your hands.

events.name: The Heart: One Crystal
events.intro: One crystal stays lit, if you choose it. Its light at half strength, for good.

success.text: It stops humming in your hand, and goes quiet, and stays.
It stops humming in your hand, and goes quiet, and stays.
It stops humming in your hand, and goes quiet, and stays.
You look again.

events.name: The Heart: One Crystal
events.intro: One crystal stays lit, if you choose it.

success.text: It stops humming in your hand, and goes quiet, and stays.
It stops humming in your hand, and goes quiet, and stays.
You let them go dark.

events.name: The Heart: The Wall
events.intro:
Where it folded, the wall moves once more. A Carbink climbs out of it, and looks at you, and follows.

Where it set your crystals into itself, the rock still shows their colours, faintly. They hum once, and go quiet.

success.text: It walks at your heel all the way to the light.

marks: came out of the wall in the Crystal Caverns

events.name: The Heart: The Wall
events.intro: It doesn't follow you. It folds back into the wall, and the humming goes on without you.

success.text: The light leads you out.

events.name: The Crystal Caverns: The Way Out

remembers.intro: At the mouth of the cave, the one that followed you all the way stops, and looks at you.

success.text: It doesn't run.
It watches you go. Then it turns, and goes back in, toward the hum.

events.intro: Daylight, at last. Behind you, the hum goes on.

success.text: The crystals in your bag go quiet the moment the sun touches them.

events.name: The Sunken City
events.intro:
Off the shore, the tops of towers. A whole city, under clear water, laid out like a map of itself.

The fishermen don't go near it. "It isn't haunted," one says. "It's just *somebody's.*"

success.text: At low tide the old causeway is out of the water, stone by stone. You walk out to the towers.
The tide is in. You take a breath, and go down, past the tops of the towers, into the streets.
The towers go under as the tide turns.

events.name: The Sunken City: The Stairs
events.intro:
A wide stair, going down into green water, where three districts meet.

There is no narrator here, and nobody to ask. Just the streets.

success.text: You go down toward the stalls.

effects.text: No Water-type to swim the flooded stairs. You go the long way round, over the roofs. It takes a while.
*In your Notebook, in your own hand: They had time.*

success.text: You go along a street of doorways.

effects.text: No Water-type to swim the flooded stairs. You go the long way round, over the roofs. It takes a while.
*In your Notebook, in your own hand: They had time.*

success.text: You go toward the dome.

effects.text: No Water-type to swim the flooded stairs. You go the long way round, over the roofs. It takes a while.
*In your Notebook, in your own hand: They had time.*

success.text: Below the temple, a round door.

events.name: The Sunken City: The Market
events.intro:
*Stalls, under four fathoms of clear water. Weights on the scales. Baskets stacked. A broom leaning where someone left it.*

It's laid out as if for tomorrow. Nothing is overturned. Nothing was dropped.

A Corsola sits behind one counter, a Krabby behind another, like shopkeepers waiting to open.

success.text: The shopkeepers don't like browsers.
It's stiff, but it moves. Something below the stalls clanks awake.

choices.label: Put the weight back on the scale.

success.text: It sits in its pan as if it had never moved. The scale settles, level. Somewhere below, something old turns to watch.
Back up the stairs.

events.name: The Market: The Wheel
events.intro: Two ways to turn it: drain the cellar under the stalls, or flood the square.

success.text: The water goes out of the cellar with a long sigh. On the floor, in the silt: a scale-weight, stamped with a fish.
Clean water pours over the square. Your Water-types roll in it like it's home.
You leave the wheel where it is.

events.name: The Market: The Cellar
events.intro: A scale-weight, stamped with a fish. Somebody weighed things fairly here, every day, for a long time.

success.text: It's heavier than it looks.
You leave it in the silt.

events.name: The Sunken City: The Houses
events.intro:
*A street of doorways. Beside each door, at shoulder height, marks cut in the stone. A line. A date. Above it, another line. Another date.*

In one house, a table set for a meal. Under each plate, a sandbag.

On a windowsill, a child's clay boat, pointing out to sea.

success.text:
High-water marks, carved and dated, each a little higher. The lowest are at the ankle.

They go up slowly: a hand's width in a lifetime.

effects.text: With the street drained you can read them to the top: over the lintel. The last date is very neat.
At the very top, one new line. Very recent. Cut by nobody.

success.text: It turns. Water moves somewhere behind the walls.
The clay boat, pointing out to sea.
Back up the stairs.

events.name: The Houses: The Windowsill

remembers.notice: *Once, at the Lantern Sea, you floated a boat. Below the windowsill, in the dark water, something is waiting to light the way.*

events.intro: A child's clay boat on the sill, pointing out to sea. Outside the window, open water.

choices.label: Take the clay boat from the sill.

success.text: It fits in one hand. Somebody small made it, and pressed their thumb into the bow.

choices.label: Set the boat on the water outside the window.

success.text:
It floats.

It turns, slowly, until it points out to sea, the way it was.

effects.text: It goes out through the gate on its own. Something below lights its way.

success.text: You leave the sill as it is.

events.name: The Houses: The Wheel
events.intro: Two ways to turn it: drain the street, or flood the lower houses.

success.text: The street drains. The marks go all the way up, over the lintels, clear and dry.
The lower houses fill. Now there's a way through them, by swimming, straight to the stairs.
You leave it.
Back along the street.

events.name: The Sunken City: The Temple

remembers.notice: *The dome is full of water now. The mural shows through it, bright as the day it was painted.*

events.intro: *A dome, still whole. Inside, dry air, and a mural that runs all the way round.*

success.text:
The mural has the sea drawn inside the walls, and the people walking out. In a line. Carrying things. Children on shoulders. Pokémon beside them.

Nobody's running.

At the end, the last figure is looking back. It's holding something small in both hands. It puts it down.
It's the heaviest of the three.
Back up the stairs.

events.name: The Temple: The Wheel
events.intro: Two ways to turn it: drain the crypt below, or flood the dome.

success.text: The crypt drains. On a hook by the stair, a bronze key, shaped like a coelacanth.
You put your hands on the wheel.
You leave it.

events.name: The Temple: Flood the Dome?
events.intro: The dome is the only dry room in the city. The mural is in it. Flood it?

success.text: You lean on the wheel.
You take your hands off the wheel.

events.name: The Temple: Are You Sure?
events.intro: Somebody painted every one of those people. Are you sure?

success.text:
The water comes in from the floor up. You watch the paint.

It holds. Somebody, a long time ago, made sure it would.
You let the wheel go back. The dome stays dry.

events.name: The Temple: The Crypt
events.intro: A bronze key, shaped like a coelacanth, on its hook. Below the temple, a round door with a slot shaped like a bell.

success.text: It's cold. The coelacanth's eye is a tiny hole, worn smooth by a thumb.
You leave it on its hook.

events.name: The Sunken City: The Archive

remembers.notice: *The bell fits the slot exactly. You ring it once, and the door rolls aside.*

events.intro:
*Shelves cut in the rock. On them, clay tablets, thousands, stacked like plates.*

*Something very old turns in the water in front of them.*

An ancient Relicanth. It isn't guarding treasure. It's guarding the last record of who lived here: every name.

choices.label: Hang the key back on its hook.

success.text: The key goes back on its hook by the door. The Relicanth watches it settle.
It looks at what you've put back, and what you haven't.

effects.text: After the third, it moves aside.

choices.label: Fight it, with what you took.

success.text: It doesn't leave the shelves. It doesn't need to.

events.name: The Archive: The Small Tablet
events.intro:
*One tablet's been set apart from the others, on a cushion of weed. It's small. It fits in both hands.*

*It's the thing the last figure in the mural put down.*

success.text:
It's cold. It has marks on it that aren't writing, yet.

Beside it, a little crown, a child's, made for a festival that never came again.
It's cold. It has marks on it that aren't writing, yet. You already have the crown that was beside it, once.

events.name: The Archive: Look, Don't Touch
events.intro:
It lets you look. Not touch.

Thousands of names. You read a few. They're ordinary names.

success.text: It turns in the water as you go.

effects.text: On the stair, as if somebody left it for you: a Pearl String.
On the stair, as if somebody left it for you: a Relic Vase.

events.name: The Archive: In the Way
events.intro:
It sinks in front of the shelves. Even now, it's in the way.

You reach past it. The small tablet on its cushion of weed comes away in your hand.

success.text: Nothing stops you. That's the worst part.

events.name: A Potter's Stall
events.intro:
In a coastal town, a potter sells little clay boats to tourists. Each has a thumbprint pressed into the bow.

She doesn't know where the shape comes from. "My grandmother made them," she says. "Her grandmother, too, I think."

choices.label: Ask where the shape comes from.

success.text: "From the sea, Gran said. From before." She shrugs, and smiles, and presses her thumb into the next one.
You walk on. The boats on her table all point the same way: out to sea.

events.name: The Ground Opens
events.intro:
*The Small Tablet's warm. Then it's hot.*

*The marks on it move. They line up. They point down.*

*The ground in front of you folds open like a book.*

success.text: Steps, cut for feet a little bigger than yours. The walls are moving.

events.name: Caverns-o-Mighty: The Corridor

remembers.notice: *Every word on the walls is the same one, the whole way down. THIEF.*

events.intro:
The Unown are the cave. They're the only things alive down here, and they're on every wall.

They spell words. Not to you. To each other. HERE. WAIT. STILL. A long one: WE KEPT IT.

*Halfway along, they stop. They arrange themselves into your name. And hold it. Then the letters look at you, all at once, one eye each.*

success.text: Your own name comes back off the walls, softer each time, until it's only the Unown saying it.
You hold up your hands and wait. The letters come.
The name stays behind you. It's spelled right.

events.name: Caverns-o-Mighty: Spell Something Back
events.intro: Which word? One you've seen on the walls.

success.text: They copy it, pleased. HERE, all down the corridor.
They copy it, pleased. WAIT, all down the corridor.
They copy it, pleased. STILL, all down the corridor.
They copy it, pleased. WE KEPT IT, all down the corridor.

*Every word on the walls is the same one, the whole way down. THIEF.*
*So many letters are gone from the walls now. What's left is hard to read.*

events.intro:
A carving of a balance, with a fish on one side and nothing on the other. Below it, a row of five empty niches.

Loose Unown drift in the air. You can lead them, one at a time, to the niches.

choices.label: Lead the Unown to the niches.

success.text: You hold out a hand. One drifts down to it, curious.
They come off the wall like leaves in a wind.

events.name: Caverns-o-Mighty: The End

remembers.notice: *The dots light, but the door behind them opens on one you didn't choose.*
*Every word on the walls is the same one, the whole way down. THIEF.*
*On the walls, all the way round, the Unown spell the word you gave them.*

events.intro:
*Seven dots light, one after another.*

*It doesn't move toward you. It was put here to wait for the tablet, and the tablet's come.*

success.text: It takes it. It sets it into its own chest, where there's a space the right size.
The dots flare.
It doesn't bounce off. It closes. It shakes once, twice, three times, and stays shut. Seven dots go dark, one after another.

failure.text: It bounces off. At full strength, there was almost no chance: about one in a hundred. You could see that.

events.name: Caverns-o-Mighty: It Has What It Waited For
events.intro: It has what it was waiting for. It stands a little lower now, the way you do after a long day.

success.text: It fights, but its heart isn't in it.
It fights at full strength. It doesn't know you.

events.name: Caverns-o-Mighty: Still
events.intro:
It goes still, the dots dark. Where it stood, something rare of its own kind, and the Small Tablet, cracked.

The tablet hums, faintly, when you turn toward other sealed doors.

success.text: Cold, both of them.
